svg.title: The Rust Express
svg.desc: Top-down cartoon loop map of the finished line. Rust track the whole way: out through the orange Gate and Router checkpoints, through the Cache, Vault and Customs stations built over the track, into four Rust lines, and back around the bottom through the Post office and Ledger. Trains tagged Chat, OCR, Messages and Responses roll through without stopping. One small wooden hut between the tracks, labeled your own Python callback, still sits off the track with crates waiting to be repacked.
svg.text: Track the whole loop and Rust at every stop: the trip the test track was measuring.
